title: SWF font glyph export: replace placeholder empty glyphs with real outlines
description:
packages/swf/src/fonts.ts emits 95 placeholder glyphs (all with empty contour arrays) for every embedded font. Text in published SWFs is invisible or substituted by Ruffle because no glyph outlines exist in DefineFont2/DefineFont3.

Flash 8's canonical approach: use the browser Canvas 2D API to extract glyph outlines — fill a canvas with a single character using the chosen font, then trace the pixels into bezier paths, or use the measureText/fontBoundingBox metrics to construct synthetic outlines. Alternatively, use opentype.js (already a common approach for web SWF tools) to parse a bundled font file and extract real contours.

Acceptance criteria:
- DefineFont2 tags in published SWFs contain non-empty GlyphShapeTable records for ASCII 32-126.
- Static text objects using a standard font (Arial, Times New Roman, Verdana) are visible and legible when played in Ruffle.
- Existing font.test.ts passes and gains at least one test asserting glyphShapes[0].records.length > 0 for a common font.

Key files: packages/swf/src/fonts.ts (encodeDefineFont2, glyph generation), packages/swf/src/text.ts.
